quarterly_data.quarter: SPX Technologies press release: SPX Technologies Announces Acquisition of FIS Water (09-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: SPX completed the acquisition of FIS Water, whose LAKOS, Puroflux, Superior, VAF and VSI brands provide water management and control solutions used primarily in commercial and industrial cooling applications (removing solids, maintaining water quality, controlling water flow), serving many of the same customers and channels as SPX's Cooling platform, including data centers. FIS Water joined the HVAC segment within the Cooling platform; its valve and actuator portfolio complements Neptronic. FIS Water has approximately 120 employees and is expected to generate revenue of approximately $105 million in 2026; SPX will provide updated 2026 guidance including FIS Water with its Q3 2026 results.
quarterly_data.figure: FIS Water: ~120 employees; ~$105 million expected 2026 revenue; joins HVAC segment / Cooling platform
